fields.statement: QA at dde99439c with a scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza), in a scratch Rhiza root and repo with fake rex and fake claude scripts (the fake claude logs role, leaf, attempt and --model; builders commit one file per leaf, verifiers write Evidence), run under env -i. rhiza run start --foreground --workflow build on three chained leaves: plain (commits internal/x/plain.go), risky (.github/workflows/ci.yml), testy (internal/x/x_test.go). Run succeeded; the journal's leaf-session models were plain verifier sonnet, risky verifier opus, testy verifier opus, builders sonnet. With plain's first verifier failing: plain builder 2 opus, plain verifier attempt 2 opus (retry stays strong), others as before, run succeeded. With a project .rhiza/workflows/build.toml overriding the verifier to models [opus] only: all three verifiers opus (no tiering, as before). With an override of low_risk_models [haiku], risky_paths [internal/x/risky.go, **/*.yml]: plain haiku, risky opus, testy haiku. Review's fixed-leaf verifier was not driven hands-on; go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestVerifierTier|TestVerifierRisky' ok.

QA at dde99439c with a scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza), in a scratch Rhiza root and repo with fake rex and fake claude scripts (the fake claude logs role, leaf, attempt and --model; builders commit one file per leaf, verifiers write Evidence), run under env -i. rhiza workflow describe build and describe review each print role verifier models [opus], low_risk_models [sonnet] and the twelve risky_paths globs (*_test.go, **/*_test.go, **/testdata/**, **/main_test.go, .githooks/**, **/hooks/**, .github/**, .rhiza/workflows/**, internal/workflow/builtin/**, **/migrations/**, **/migrate/**, **/*retry*). A run of the built-in build workflow verified a leaf changing internal/x/plain.go on sonnet and leaves changing .github/workflows/ci.yml and internal/x/x_test.go on opus. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok. Note: cmd/rhiza testscript build-workflow still expects opus verifiers for its low-risk leaves and now fails (passes at the merge-base), recorded as a finding.

QA at dde99439c with a scratch build (go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza), in a scratch Rhiza root and repo with fake rex and fake claude scripts (the fake claude logs role, leaf, attempt and --model; builders commit one file per leaf, verifiers write Evidence), run under env -i. rhiza workflow check on project workflows: a leaves verifier with low_risk_models [haiku] and risky_paths [docs/**] is valid, as is a checks step's verifier with both; refused with a message naming the verifier role: low_risk_models on a leaves builder, risky_paths on a check ("set them under [step.review.verifier]"), low_risk_models on a checks fixer, low_risk_models on an agent step ("has no verifier"); refused: low_risk_models [" "] (entry 1 is blank), risky_paths [""] (entry 1 is empty), risky_paths ["a/[b"] (not a valid glob). rhiza workflow describe shows role verifier low_risk_models [haiku] and risky_paths [docs/**]; --json carries low_risk_models and risky_paths on each role (empty for the builder). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(workflow-describe|describe-golden)$' ok.
